polityNote: Republic of Chad from independence (1960-08-11) to the regions of 2002-10-17 (TCD.json draws from then). Prefectures 1960–1999 (11; 13 from 1962-01-09; 14 from 1962-10-29) and the 28 departments of decree 355/PR/MISD/99 (1999-09-01). Atoms: OCHA departments of 2012–2025 (geoBoundaries TCD ADM2, CC BY 3.0 IGO). A prefecture is drawn only when (a) every later department lies inside it and no recorded sub-prefecture change crosses its outline (statoids ytd: c.1973, c.1986, decrees 226 and 354 of 1999, 2002, 2008, 2012), and (b) the OCHA department lines on its outline agree with the independent OSM region outline (gb ADM1). Four lines where OCHA differs from both OSM and Natural Earth by a block 7–15 km wide (Wayi, Loug-Chari, Wadi Hawar/Mourtcha, Haraze-Mangueigne) are left unresolved together with every prefecture they bound. OCHA’s own 2025 revision of the layer (COD-AB valid_on 2025-02-12, same 70 departments) moved two of those four lines to where OSM and Natural Earth have them (35% of Wayi now in Dagana/Hadjer-Lamis, 6.7% of Loug-Chari now in Bahr Koh/Moyen-Chari), while every atom of the drawn prefectures falls ≥97.6% inside the same prefecture under the 2025 lines. Colonial Chad before 1960-08-11 is left to Müller-Crepon (Harvard Dataverse DVN/9JI06R, CC0), whose col_units_full.geojson holds Chad (COW 483) at 1938 and 1946. ① Published 1993 prefecture areas (statoids) vs the drawn unions: Batha 88,800 vs 91,421 km² (1.030); Guéra 58,950 vs 61,273 (1.039); Kanem 114,520 vs 123,643 (1.080); Logone Occidental 8,695 vs 8,888 (1.022); Logone Oriental 28,035 vs 23,794 (0.849); Mayo-Kebbi 30,105 vs 30,630 (1.017); Tandjilé 18,045 vs 17,601 (0.975); national total 1,284,000 vs 1,269,250 (0.989). The published areas are old round figures (Logone Oriental 0.849 beside Moyen-Chari 1.286 suggests the 1960s figures placed that line differently; OSM and OCHA agree on it today).
